snippet.title: Tideward: An Idle Almanac | Official Trailer (Cozy Idle RPG)
snippet.description:
A keeper, a quiet coast, and twenty-eight trades, each worked in its own little world. Set a trade going, close the app, and come back to what the almanac kept. Build a ship from the keel up, find pets as you play, and face a living bestiary.

No ads. No subscription. No loot boxes. Every purchase is direct and one-time.

Out February 11, 2027. Pre-order on the App Store for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV, Apple Watch and Apple Vision Pro. The Android open beta is on Google Play, and the PC version is coming to Steam.
Free betas: https://tideward.app/install/

Made by one developer at Manu Games. https://tideward.app
